'''Jasshi<nowiki>'</nowiki>rr''' was the name of the ancient [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] ceremony. Tales stated that the ceremony was presided over by a [[Unidentified crystal skull|crystal skull]] carved from the crystallized ashes of a fallen Twi'lek hero.<ref name="Idol Intentions">''{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}''</ref>
